items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Louis Armstrong was raised right up. Is that right? That neighborhood too.

ctx.x: Yeah, well the starting of it was at, at that time, the starting of it was at Liberty Street on Gravy. Yeah. And it went on up. I remember that much from it.
And Louis Armstrong was raised right up. Is that right? That neighborhood too.

I know Claris Williams, he had his music publishing company, well I guess it was a publishing company then, right around the corner on Tulane. Yeah. And I used to go around there and just hang around to hear the music and what not that was coming out. He would be playing, or different fathers would be in there playing and getting a thing. Well that was right around the corner on Tulane. Yeah.
